=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text sp " "
text minus "-"
text tins "insert "
text tpop "pop "
text tdata "3 Clear drains|4 Feed cat|5 Make tea|1 Solve RC tasks|2 Tax return"
global heap ulong 16
global pri ulong 16
global hn ulong 1
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
note a binary min-heap of task numbers keyed by priority: heap[0] has the smallest pri; the five tasks
note are the |-separated entries of tdata, each a priority digit and a name
fn entry k ulong to void
f = ulong 0
st = ulong 0
for i ulong len tdata
if eq get tdata i 124
if eq f k
emit part tdata st sub i st
ret
end
f = add f 1
st = add i 1
end
end
emit part tdata st sub len tdata st
end
fn swap i ulong j ulong to void
t = get heap i
put heap i get heap j
put heap j t
end
fn less i ulong j ulong to bool
ret lt get pri get heap i get pri get heap j
end
note insert sifts the new task up; the index halves each step, so 16 steps bound it
fn insert k ulong p ulong to void
put pri k p
n = get hn 0
put heap n k
put hn 0 add n 1
i = n
while gt i 0 bound 16
u = shr sub i 1 1
if not less i u
break
end
swap i u
i = u
end
emit tins
entry k
emit nl
end
note popmin moves the last task to the root and sifts it down; the index doubles each step
fn popmin to void
n = sub get hn 0 1
k = get heap 0
put heap 0 get heap n
put hn 0 n
i = ulong 0
while lt add mul i 2 1 n bound 16
c = add mul i 2 1
if lt add c 1 n
if less add c 1 c
c = add c 1
end
end
if not less c i
break
end
swap i c
i = c
end
emit tpop
entry k
emit nl
end
fn main to int
st = ulong 0
k = ulong 0
for i ulong len tdata
if eq i st
insert k ulong sub get tdata i 48
k = add k 1
end
if eq get tdata i 124
st = add i 1
end
end
for x ulong k
popmin
end
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>
insert 3 Clear drains
insert 4 Feed cat
insert 5 Make tea
insert 1 Solve RC tasks
insert 2 Tax return
pop 1 Solve RC tasks
pop 2 Tax return
pop 3 Clear drains
pop 4 Feed cat
pop 5 Make tea
</pre>
